The '''Sith holocron''' was a large pyramidal [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]].

==History==
The [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] was found on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] on one of his earliest trips to the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] burial world. He later relocated it to the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center|EmPal SuRecon Center]] and used it as part of his Dark Force reservoir.
